# Dice Bandits M4a Visual Polish Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make the live game look as close as possible to the approved concept art (16-bit board, large facing battle fighters, card commands, edge HUD) without changing any rule.

**Architecture:** Art is generated by the controller with the Codex image backend (concept images attached as references), normalised by an extended `tools/pixelize` into palette-locked spritesheets + JSON atlases under `apps/client/public/sprites/`, and consumed by a new client `art/` module. Board and battle scenes are rebuilt as small layer modules behind the existing awaitable event-playback contract; DOM HUD is re-laid out keeping every existing `data-testid`.

**Tech Stack:** Phaser 3 (pixelArt), TypeScript, Vite, sharp (pixelize), Vitest + happy-dom, Playwright 1.63, Cloudflare Workers (unchanged).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-dice-bandits-m4a-visuals-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Engine (`packages/engine`), room (`packages/room`), worker (`apps/client/worker`) and protocol are NOT modified.
- Base resolution 640×360, Phaser `pixelArt: true`, `roundPixels`, `Scale.FIT`; sprites drawn at integer scale only.
- Shipped sprite pixels: only colours of `tools/pixelize/palette.json` (32 colours) + full transparency. Backdrops may use `tools/pixelize/palette-backdrop.json` (32 colours). Palettes may be regenerated once (Task 1) and are locked afterwards.
- Every existing `data-testid` keeps its name and meaning. Existing unit + E2E tests must pass unchanged (only additions allowed).
- Every new visible string exists in both `apps/client/src/i18n/en.json` and `th.json`; Thai text wraps, never truncates.
- `?speed=0` → all animations instant; `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` → no shake, no flash, no ambient loops.
- Total PNG under `apps/client/public/sprites/` ≤ 1.5 MB.
- Missing/failed atlas → fall back to the M1 sprite + `console.warn`, never crash.
- Test hooks only with `VITE_TEST_HOOKS=1`; production build contains no `__db`.
- Full gate for every task: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:worker && npm run sim -- --games 200 --players 4 && npm run sim:room -- --games 200 && npm run build && npm run e2e`.
- Raw generated images never committed except approved references in `docs/concepts/m4/`.

## Roles and parallelism

- **Controller (Monday):** generates raw art (Tasks 2, 5, 8 "Generate" steps), vision-checks, shows contact sheets to the owner, gets approval, owns Task 12.
- **Worker (Luna):** everything else, TDD, one task per dispatch, local commits on `feat/m4a-visuals`.
- Parallel-safe groups (separate worktrees, no shared files): {Task 1, Task 3} → then {Task 2+4, Task 7} → {Task 5+6, Task 9} → {Task 8+10} → Task 11 → Task 12.

### Task 1: pixelize `sheet` mode + atlas format

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/pixelize/pixelize.ts`, `tools/pixelize/README.md`
- Create: `tools/pixelize/sheets.json` (empty `{"sheets": []}` for now), `tools/pixelize/fixtures/sheet-3.png` (3 frames 30×30 each on flat grey, made by the test helper), `tools/pixelize/palette-backdrop.json`
- Test: `tools/pixelize/pixelize.test.ts`

**Interfaces — Produces:**
```ts
export type SheetEntry = {
  name: string;                 // output basename, e.g. "hero-knight"
  source: string;               // path relative to sheets.json
  frames: number;               // frames in one row, equal widths
  cell: { width: number; height: number };   // output cell in art pixels
  palette?: 'main' | 'backdrop';
  animations: Record<string, { from: number; to: number; fps: number; loop: boolean }>;
  anchor?: 'feet' | 'center';   // default 'feet'
};
export type Atlas = {
  image: string;                // "<name>.png"
  cell: { width: number; height: number };
  frames: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }[];
  anchor: { x: number; y: number };        // in cell pixels
  animations: Record<string, { frames: number[]; fps: number; loop: boolean }>;
};
export async function buildSheet(entry: SheetEntry, baseDir: string, outDir: string): Promise<Atlas>;
```
CLI: `npx tsx tools/pixelize/pixelize.ts --sheets tools/pixelize/sheets.json --out apps/client/public/sprites [--only <name>]` writes `<name>.png` (frames packed left→right) + `<name>.json`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write failing tests** in `pixelize.test.ts`:
```ts
// tmp / tmp2: fresh mkdtemp dirs per test (beforeEach); toolDir = dirname of pixelize.ts
const entry: SheetEntry = {
  name: 't3', source: 'fixtures/sheet-3.png', frames: 3, cell: { width: 16, height: 16 },
  animations: { idle: { from: 0, to: 2, fps: 6, loop: true } },
};
it('slices a row sheet into equal cells with feet anchor', async () => {
  const atlas = await buildSheet(entry, toolDir, tmp);
  expect(atlas.frames).toHaveLength(3);
  expect(atlas.frames.every((f) => f.w === 16 && f.h === 16)).toBe(true);
  expect(atlas.anchor).toEqual({ x: 8, y: 16 });
  expect(atlas.animations.idle).toEqual({ frames: [0, 1, 2], fps: 6, loop: true });
});
async function rawPixels(path: string) {
  const { data, info } = await sharp(path).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
  return { data, width: info.width, height: info.height };
}
it('uses only palette colours or full transparency', async () => {
  await buildSheet(entry, toolDir, tmp);
  const palette = new Set(
    (JSON.parse(await readFile(join(toolDir, 'palette.json'), 'utf8')) as string[]).map((h) => h.toLowerCase()),
  );
  const { data } = await rawPixels(join(tmp, 't3.png'));
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
    expect([0, 255]).toContain(data[i + 3]);
    if (data[i + 3] === 255) {
      const hex = '#' + [data[i], data[i + 1], data[i + 2]].map((v) => v.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
      expect(palette.has(hex)).toBe(true);
    }
  }
});
it('is deterministic', async () => {
  await buildSheet(entry, toolDir, tmp);
  await buildSheet(entry, toolDir, tmp2);
  expect((await readFile(join(tmp, 't3.png'))).equals(await readFile(join(tmp2, 't3.png')))).toBe(true);
  expect(await readFile(join(tmp, 't3.json'), 'utf8')).toBe(await readFile(join(tmp2, 't3.json'), 'utf8'));
});
it('baseline-aligns frames (lowest opaque row equal in every frame)', async () => {
  const atlas = await buildSheet(entry, toolDir, tmp);
  const { data, width } = await rawPixels(join(tmp, 't3.png'));
  const lowest = atlas.frames.map((f) => {
    for (let y = f.y + f.h - 1; y >= f.y; y--)
      for (let x = f.x; x < f.x + f.w; x++) if (data[(y * width + x) * 4 + 3] === 255) return y - f.y;
    return -1;
  });
  expect(new Set(lowest).size).toBe(1);
  expect(lowest[0]).toBe(atlas.cell.height - 1);
});
```
The fixture helper draws 3 coloured blobs of different heights on `#808080` with sharp at test start.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the spec** (run on both projects, EN and TH via the language toggle):
```ts
test('board and battle fit the viewport without truncation', async ({ page }) => {
  await startTestGame(page);                      // existing helper
  for (const lang of ['en', 'th'] as const) {
    await page.locator(`[data-lang="${lang}"]`).first().click();
    await assertInside(page, '[data-testid="screen-board"] *:visible');   // every visible element's box within viewport
    await assertNoEllipsis(page, '[data-testid="event-banner"]');         // scrollWidth <= clientWidth for each line box
    await assertMinFont(page, '.seat-card', 12);
  }
  await playUntil(page, (s) => s.phase.kind === 'battle');                // via window.__db
  await assertInside(page, '.battle-panel *:visible', '.battle-panel');   // nothing escapes the battle panel
  const expected = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const s = window.__db.getState();
    if (s.phase.kind !== 'battle') throw new Error('not in battle');
    const a = s.phase.battle.a;
    return `${a.hp}/${a.stats.maxHp}`;
  });
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="hp-left"]')).toHaveText(expected);
});
test('reduced motion disables shake and ambient loops', async ({ browser }) => {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  await startTestGame(page);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => window.__db.art.ambientRunning)).toBe(false);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => window.__db.art.shakeCount)).toBe(0);
  await ctx.close();
});
```
(helpers `assertInside`, `assertNoEllipsis`, `assertMinFont`, `playUntil` go in `e2e/helpers.ts`. Test-hook surface, only when `VITE_TEST_HOOKS=1`: `window.__db.art = { ambientRunning: boolean; shakeCount: number }`, updated by `scenes/board/ambient.ts` and `fx.ts` `shake()`; battle HP DOM nodes carry `data-testid="hp-left"` / `"hp-right"` (added in Task 9).)
